questions.question: What does "purpose" mean?

lessons.title: Prepositions (מילות יחס)

questions.question: I'm waiting ___ the bus.
questions.explanation: 'wait for' = לחכות ל־.

questions.question: They went ___ the beach.
questions.explanation: 'to' לכיוון/יעד.

questions.question: The picture is ___ the wall.
questions.explanation: 'on the wall' = על הקיר.
